title: The J-Crown: eight championships, one target
summary: The Great Sasuke wins a tournament that gathers eight junior titles into one prize. Ultimo Dragon and Jushin Liger then contest this unusually broad claim to junior-heavyweight supremacy.

chapters.title: Sasuke wins the eight-title tournament
chapters.result: The Great Sasuke defeats Ultimo Dragon to win the J-Crown.
chapters.context: The tournament brings together titles from several promotions. The belts retain their individual histories while being defended together.

chapters.title: Liger captures the J-Crown
chapters.result: Liger defeats reigning J-Crown champion Ultimo Dragon.
chapters.context: After Dragon’s intervening reign, Liger brings the collection of belts to New Japan’s most established junior star.
